authority_model.universe: Lean source and its import/argument graph
authority_model.rule: Papers explain, Comparator checks the Lean statements of paper results against separately declared copies, and Palomar holds a prepare-only corpus. None widens Lean’s proposition or records peer review/acceptance unless its own source says so.

route_contract.rule: All generated routes are relative to lean/experience/. Absolute source_github routes always identify the canonical public source.

status_rule.lean: exact and exact_or_stronger: the named declarations jointly state the result, the second implying it by an immediate specialisation. modulo_named_input: they state it under the named Lean propositions. none: no Lean statement is recorded; counted false marks a statement the maintainer count has not read yet.
status_rule.comparator: compared: a recorded Comparator replay in the corpus repository checked every named declaration (entries, run ids and corpus commits recorded). pending: exact Lean evidence waiting on that replay; queued_at is the date the row entered the worklist. not_applicable: no exact Lean statement.
status_rule.palomar: prepared: the compared corpus entry is in the prepare-only Palomar corpus; submission and acceptance are operator decisions recorded elsewhere. pending: waiting on Comparator. not_applicable: no exact Lean statement.

frontend_handoff.paper_math_preference: exact TeX/MathJax with native MathML fallback artifact

performance_contract.delivery: pre-generated static JSON and HTML; no runtime repository analysis
performance_contract.render_cache: content-addressed by source hash, renderer version, and Pandoc version
performance_contract.frontend_expectation: fetch manifest first, then only the selected problem or overlay
